recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future PACP or other document FormatCode additions should be handled in THO/UTG or the IHE FormatCode package unless a future FHIR-core Jira explicitly changes the DocumentReference binding.
issue_request: FHIR-14104 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 DocumentReference and terminology-valuesets issue requesting urn:hl7-org:sdwg:pacp-structuredBody:1.0 and urn:hl7-org:sdwg:pacp-nonXMLBody:1.0 be added to the FHIR Format Code Value Set. The final resolution required creating an HL7-managed code system through harmonization, adding the codes there, verifying the modeling, and updating the IHE/FHIR format-code value set composition.
initial_application: Git commit cc53370316b463e09e710d62a51582332a5832e4 explicitly attempted to apply FHIR-14104 by updating source/documentreference/valueset-formatcodes.xml to compose IHE, HL7 document format, and DICOM sources. Jira comments recorded that this local composition failed in the core build. PR #1710, merged as ad1b6c072ad346fd59fbccea8e0409d27acf9abf, included commit 6f1b3314e9956e3c1eb469c13860238345e02d20, which removed the local valueset-formatcodes.xml and rebound DocumentReference to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-HL7FormatCodes.
additional_context: FHIR-32583 later changed DocumentReference.content.format into DocumentReference.content.profile.value[x], with source/fhir.ini preserving the migration map. DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini, and no local valueset-formatcodes source entry remains. The cached hl7.terminology.r5#5.3.0 package shows ValueSet v3-HL7FormatCodes includes IHE format codes and CodeSystem v3-HL7DocumentFormatCodes, whose concepts include both requested PACP 1.0 codes. Zulip, Confluence, and UP-241 show the terminology publication path from the original FHIR-14104 uncertainty to THO-managed HL7/IHE code-system composition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk is needed because the current build-scope binding already points to the external value set that contains the requested codes, and restoring a core-local FormatCodes value set would duplicate and partially reverse the later THO handoff.
